frozenStrategyRules: pending replacement obligations come before untouched primaries WITHIN a window that contains a replacement
multiple obligations are ordered by selectionIndex ascending
unused reserves are walked monotonically in frozen reserve-rank order (Owner Clarification Q1)
untouched primaries continue by selectionIndex ascending
a replacement inherits its slot's split
a failed reserve creates a same-slot replacement chain in a future separately precommitted window (Owner Clarification Q2)
the next chain link replaces the CURRENT occupant of the slot
a replacement reason is the CURRENT occupant's adjudicated reason (Owner Clarification Q3)
no dynamic insertion, no window enlargement and no shrinking to optimise split mix
strategy selection does not assign or consume a reserve
reserve consumption occurs only after a future canonical ledger row is appended, committed and pushed before institution network
no institution identity, URL/domain characteristic, expected yield, split composition or past outcome chooses or orders work
frozenStrategyRuleScopeNote: the ordering rule binds the composition of a window that SERVES an obligation; it does not itself require that every window serve one. A window containing zero replacements satisfies it vacuously, which is the shape the landed post-P12 strategy recorded as methodologicallyAllowed and the shape the immediately preceding accepted window (P:31-P:35) already executed

overstatedSuccessCount.sharperStatementOfKnownFinding4: at a ten-entry ledger the adapter's P6 cross-check has NO discriminating power over the success count at all: p6Derived = entryCount > 10 AND successes < 50, and entryCount > 10 is false unconditionally, so p6Derived is false for every success count from 0 to 110.
